name: How do painters prepare kitchen surfaces before applying paint?

mainEntity.name: How do painters prepare kitchen surfaces before applying paint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Thorough surface preparation is essential in kitchens due to airborne grease, cooking oils, and food splatters that stop paint from bonding properly. The process begins with cleaning surfaces using a heavy-duty degreaser, followed by patching nail holes and fixing moisture-damaged drywall. Next, surfaces are lightly sanded to smooth uneven spots and create mechanical adhesion. High-adhesion, stain-blocking primers are applied over repaired spots, bare wood, or water marks. Finally, drop cloths and plastic sheeting are placed to shield countertops, appliances, and flooring before paint application starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prep involves washing off grease with degreasers, repairing drywall flaws, sanding surfaces smooth, applying stain-blocking primer, and masking off countertops and appliances.
